title: Meadow hay
description: One clump of tall meadow grass for a 1 m meadow cell: four leaning golden-green tufts, loose blades flopping outward and seven thin stems with pale seed heads. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + head), instanced.
checks: 3/4 tile: tall golden-green grass with pale seed heads standing above the blades
TOP tile: the clump stays inside the 1 m cell and covers most of it
FRONT tile: the tallest seed head reaches the top of the box (0.8 m), everything starts on the grid line
